# Pembentukan datetime yang robust untuk format waktu Excel
if (inherits(dat$Waktu, "POSIXt")) {
  time_txt <- format(dat$Waktu, "%H:%M:%S")
} else {
  sec <- round(as.numeric(dat$Waktu) * 86400)
  time_txt <- sprintf("%02d:%02d:%02d", (sec %/% 3600) %% 24, (sec %% 3600) %/% 60, sec %% 60)
}
dat$Datetime <- as.POSIXct(paste(as.Date(dat$Tanggal), time_txt), tz = "Asia/Jakarta")
dat <- dat[order(dat$Datetime), ]
dat$Suhu <- as.numeric(dat[["Suhu Rata Rata (°C)"]])
stopifnot(nrow(dat) == 240)

1. Tujuan

Analisis ini membandingkan SMA, DMA, SES, DES Brown, dan Holt-Winters pada data suhu hourly Bogor bagian 4. Metode terbaik ditentukan terutama dari RMSE data testing. RMSE digunakan sebagai ukuran utama karena satuannya tetap °C. MAPE dihitung sebagai informasi tambahan, tetapi persentase pada skala Celsius perlu ditafsirkan hati-hati karena Celsius merupakan skala interval.

4. Training dan Testing

n_train <- 192
train <- dat$Suhu[1:n_train]
test <- dat$Suhu[(n_train + 1):nrow(dat)]
train_time <- dat$Datetime[1:n_train]
test_time <- dat$Datetime[(n_train + 1):nrow(dat)]

data.frame(
  Bagian = c("Training", "Testing"),
  Observasi = c(length(train), length(test)),
  Mulai = c(as.character(min(train_time)), as.character(min(test_time))),
  Selesai = c(as.character(max(train_time)), as.character(max(test_time)))
) %>% kable()
Bagian Observasi Mulai Selesai

Testing 48 2025-02-08 2025-02-09 23:00:00

Evaluasi testing menggunakan walk-forward one-step-ahead: setiap jam diprediksi satu langkah ke depan, kemudian nilai aktual yang sudah diketahui dipakai untuk memperbarui state sebelum memprediksi jam berikutnya.

5. Fungsi Metode Pemulusan

rmse <- function(actual, pred) sqrt(mean((actual - pred)^2))

# --- SMA ---
sma_train_rmse <- function(x, k) {
  idx <- (k + 1):length(x)
  pred <- sapply(idx, function(t) mean(x[(t - k):(t - 1)]))
  rmse(x[idx], pred)
}
sma_walk <- function(train, test, k) {
  hist <- train
  pred <- numeric(length(test))
  for (i in seq_along(test)) {
    pred[i] <- mean(tail(hist, k))
    hist <- c(hist, test[i])
  }
  pred
}

# --- DMA ---
dma_components <- function(x, k) {
  n <- length(x)
  ma1 <- rep(NA_real_, n); ma2 <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  for (t in k:n) ma1[t] <- mean(x[(t - k + 1):t])
  for (t in (2 * k - 1):n) ma2[t] <- mean(ma1[(t - k + 1):t])
  a <- 2 * ma1 - ma2
  b <- 2 * (ma1 - ma2) / (k - 1)
  list(ma1 = ma1, ma2 = ma2, a = a, b = b)
}
dma_train_rmse <- function(x, k) {
  z <- dma_components(x, k)
  idx <- (2 * k - 1):(length(x) - 1)
  pred <- z$a[idx] + z$b[idx]
  rmse(x[idx + 1], pred)
}
dma_walk <- function(train, test, k) {
  hist <- train
  pred <- numeric(length(test))
  for (i in seq_along(test)) {
    z <- dma_components(hist, k)
    j <- max(which(is.finite(z$a)))
    pred[i] <- z$a[j] + z$b[j]
    hist <- c(hist, test[i])
  }
  pred
}

# --- SES ---
ses_fit <- function(x, alpha) {
  n <- length(x)
  level <- numeric(n); fitted <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  level[1] <- x[1]
  for (t in 2:n) {
    fitted[t] <- level[t - 1]
    level[t] <- alpha * x[t] + (1 - alpha) * level[t - 1]
  }
  list(level = level, fitted = fitted)
}
ses_walk <- function(train, test, alpha) {
  z <- ses_fit(train, alpha)
  state <- tail(z$level, 1)
  pred <- numeric(length(test))
  for (i in seq_along(test)) {
    pred[i] <- state
    state <- alpha * test[i] + (1 - alpha) * state
  }
  pred
}

# --- DES Brown ---
des_fit <- function(x, alpha) {
  n <- length(x)
  s1 <- numeric(n); s2 <- numeric(n)
  a <- numeric(n); b <- numeric(n)
  fitted <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  s1[1] <- x[1]; s2[1] <- x[1]
  a[1] <- x[1]; b[1] <- 0
  for (t in 2:n) {
    fitted[t] <- a[t - 1] + b[t - 1]
    s1[t] <- alpha * x[t] + (1 - alpha) * s1[t - 1]
    s2[t] <- alpha * s1[t] + (1 - alpha) * s2[t - 1]
    a[t] <- 2 * s1[t] - s2[t]
    b[t] <- (alpha / (1 - alpha)) * (s1[t] - s2[t])
  }
  list(s1 = s1, s2 = s2, a = a, b = b, fitted = fitted)
}
des_walk <- function(train, test, alpha) {
  z <- des_fit(train, alpha)
  s1 <- tail(z$s1, 1); s2 <- tail(z$s2, 1)
  aa <- tail(z$a, 1); bb <- tail(z$b, 1)
  pred <- numeric(length(test))
  for (i in seq_along(test)) {
    pred[i] <- aa + bb
    ns1 <- alpha * test[i] + (1 - alpha) * s1
    ns2 <- alpha * ns1 + (1 - alpha) * s2
    naa <- 2 * ns1 - ns2
    nbb <- (alpha / (1 - alpha)) * (ns1 - ns2)
    s1 <- ns1; s2 <- ns2; aa <- naa; bb <- nbb
  }
  pred
}

# --- Holt-Winters Additive ---
hw_fit_manual <- function(x, m, alpha, beta, gamma) {
  n <- length(x)
  l0 <- mean(x[1:m])
  b0 <- if (n >= 2 * m) mean((x[(m + 1):(2 * m)] - x[1:m]) / m) else 0
  seasonal <- numeric(n)
  seasonal[1:m] <- x[1:m] - l0
  level <- rep(NA_real_, n); trend <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  fitted <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  level[m] <- l0; trend[m] <- b0
  for (t in (m + 1):n) {
    fitted[t] <- level[t - 1] + trend[t - 1] + seasonal[t - m]
    level[t] <- alpha * (x[t] - seasonal[t - m]) + (1 - alpha) * (level[t - 1] + trend[t - 1])
    trend[t] <- beta * (level[t] - level[t - 1]) + (1 - beta) * trend[t - 1]
    seasonal[t] <- gamma * (x[t] - level[t]) + (1 - gamma) * seasonal[t - m]
  }
  list(level = level, trend = trend, seasonal = seasonal, fitted = fitted)
}
hw_sse <- function(par, x, m = 24) {
  z <- hw_fit_manual(x, m, par[1], par[2], par[3])
  ok <- is.finite(z$fitted)
  sum((x[ok] - z$fitted[ok])^2)
}
hw_walk <- function(train, test, m, alpha, beta, gamma) {
  z <- hw_fit_manual(train, m, alpha, beta, gamma)
  lev <- z$level; tr <- z$trend; seas <- z$seasonal
  pred <- numeric(length(test))
  for (i in seq_along(test)) {
    t <- length(lev) + 1
    s_tm <- seas[t - m]
    prev_l <- tail(lev, 1); prev_b <- tail(tr, 1)
    pred[i] <- prev_l + prev_b + s_tm
    nl <- alpha * (test[i] - s_tm) + (1 - alpha) * (prev_l + prev_b)
    nb <- beta * (nl - prev_l) + (1 - beta) * prev_b
    ns <- gamma * (test[i] - nl) + (1 - gamma) * s_tm
    lev <- c(lev, nl); tr <- c(tr, nb); seas <- c(seas, ns)
  }
  pred
}

6. Pemilihan Parameter

# SMA & DMA: k = 2,...,24
k_grid <- 2:24
best_k_sma <- k_grid[which.min(sapply(k_grid, function(k) sma_train_rmse(train, k)))]
best_k_dma <- k_grid[which.min(sapply(k_grid, function(k) dma_train_rmse(train, k)))]

# SES
ses_opt <- optimize(function(a) {
  z <- ses_fit(train, a)
  sum((train[-1] - z$fitted[-1])^2)
}, interval = c(.001, .999))
alpha_ses <- ses_opt$minimum

# DES Brown
des_opt <- optimize(function(a) {
  z <- des_fit(train, a)
  sum((train[-1] - z$fitted[-1])^2)
}, interval = c(.001, .995))
alpha_des <- des_opt$minimum

# Holt-Winters: multi-start optimization
starts <- rbind(c(.2, .1, .2), c(.5, .1, .5), c(.8, .1, .2), c(.3, .3, .3), c(.9, .01, .1))
opts <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(starts)), function(i)
  optim(starts[i, ], hw_sse, x = train, m = 24, method = "L-BFGS-B",
        lower = rep(.001, 3), upper = rep(.999, 3)))
best_opt <- opts[[which.min(sapply(opts, function(z) z$value))]]
alpha_hw <- best_opt$par[1]
beta_hw <- best_opt$par[2]
gamma_hw <- best_opt$par[3]

parameters <- data.frame(
  Metode = c("SMA", "DMA", "SES", "DES Brown", "Holt-Winters"),
  Parameter = c(
    paste0("k=", best_k_sma),
    paste0("k=", best_k_dma),
    sprintf("alpha=%.3f", alpha_ses),
    sprintf("alpha=%.3f", alpha_des),
    sprintf("alpha=%.3f; beta=%.3f; gamma=%.3f; m=24", alpha_hw, beta_hw, gamma_hw)
  )
)
kable(parameters)
Metode Parameter
SMA k=2
DMA k=2
SES alpha=0.999
DES Brown alpha=0.745
Holt-Winters alpha=0.782; beta=0.001; gamma=0.999; m=24

7. Prediksi dan Akurasi

pred_sma <- sma_walk(train, test, best_k_sma)
pred_dma <- dma_walk(train, test, best_k_dma)
pred_ses <- ses_walk(train, test, alpha_ses)
pred_des <- des_walk(train, test, alpha_des)
pred_hw <- hw_walk(train, test, 24, alpha_hw, beta_hw, gamma_hw)

metric <- function(actual, pred) {
  e <- actual - pred
  data.frame(SSE = sum(e^2), MSE = mean(e^2), RMSE = sqrt(mean(e^2)),
             MAE = mean(abs(e)), MAPE = mean(abs(e / actual)) * 100)
}

acc <- rbind(
  SMA = metric(test, pred_sma),
  DMA = metric(test, pred_dma),
  SES = metric(test, pred_ses),
  `DES Brown` = metric(test, pred_des),
  `Holt-Winters` = metric(test, pred_hw)
)
acc$Metode <- rownames(acc)
rownames(acc) <- NULL
acc <- acc %>% arrange(RMSE)
kable(acc[, c("Metode", "SSE", "MSE", "RMSE", "MAE", "MAPE")], digits = 3)
Metode SSE MSE RMSE MAE MAPE

SES 50.559 1.053 1.026 0.723 2.864
DES Brown 60.064 1.251 1.119 0.756 3.004
DMA 73.422 1.530 1.237 0.856 3.381
SMA 76.645 1.597 1.264 0.954 3.769 
ggplot(acc, aes(reorder(Metode, RMSE), RMSE)) +

  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Perbandingan RMSE", x = "Metode", y = "RMSE (°C)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

8. Kesimpulan

Metode terbaik ditentukan dari RMSE terkecil.

best <- acc[which.min(acc$RMSE), ]
best
##        SSE      MSE      RMSE       MAE     MAPE       Metode
## 1 33.92611 0.706794 0.8407104 0.6557935 2.572387 Holt-Winters

Berdasarkan evaluasi testing, metode dengan RMSE terkecil dipilih sebagai metode terbaik. Keunggulan Holt-Winters secara substantif masuk akal apabila metode tersebut menang, karena suhu menunjukkan pola harian 24 jam yang kuat sehingga model dapat memanfaatkan komponen level, tren, dan seasonality sekaligus.
